prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your pet is hatching!", "Play with your pet preview while we prepare its desktop environment.", "Interactive pet preview", "Fun pet facts and controls"]
1: ["Meet Your Potential Pets", "Select a base species or take our quick quiz to find your ideal match.", "Discover Your Pet's Personality", "Answer quick questions to tune your pet's behavioral traits."]
2: ["Welcome Your Pet to Your Desktop!", "Here are quick shortcuts to summon, hide, and chat with your desktop companion.", "Desktop hotkeys and gesture controls", "Launch Desktop Pet"]
3: ["Signing in with your original account restores all your previous pets and progress.", "Use your primary email or social sign-in to recover existing desktop pets."]
4: ["Choose Your Adoption Path", "Pick a ready-to-go companion or design one from scratch.", "Which Pet Path Fits You?", "Tell us how much customization you prefer today."]
5: ["Ensure clear lighting and front-facing photos for best 3D model generation.", "Upload clear photo", "Checking image quality automatically..."]
6: ["You can safely minimize this window. We will alert you when your pet is ready!"]
7: ["Your Desktop Pet Awaits", "Adopt a living companion for your desktop in under 60 seconds.", "Get Started Fast"]
8: ["Official Founder Pet Badge Unlocked!", "Claim Badge & Start"]
9: ["Quick Sign In", "Sign in securely with one click to keep your desktop pets backed up."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information (a photo of the user).
Creates urgency by framing the process with a time limit ('under 60 seconds').
Mentions free extras or gifts ('Founder Pet Badge').
